rationale: Class 2 within-row adjudication. The bundle sample shows two AGY Holdings Corp. credit holdings with only '15.57% inc PIK' and no maturity, matching the two reported fmt_basis_spread violations. Raw source table 4 rows 15 and 16 are the actual debt schedule rows and contain the missing basis spread, floor, PIK split, and maturity. Raw source table 7 rows 6 and 7 are affiliate rollforward rows with shortened investment names only, explaining the extracted defect. The source therefore supports a real extraction gap rather than a false rule fire.
